#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int compute_gcd(int a, int b) {
    int gcd_value = (a > b) ? a : b;
    while (true) {
        if (a % gcd_value == 0 && b % gcd_value == 0)
            break;
        gcd_value--;
    }
    return gcd_value;
}

void calculate_difference(double x, double y, double a, double b, double &num, double &den) {
    num = fabs(x * b - y * a);
    den = y * b;
}

int main() {
    double x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    if (n > y) {
        int g = compute_gcd((int)x, (int)y);
        if (g != 1) {
            x /= g;
            y /= g;
        }
        cout << x << "/" << y << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    double min_ratio = 1e9;
    int best_a = 0, best_b = 0;

    for (double b = n; b >= 1; b--) {
        double a = (x * b) / y;
        if (floor(a) == a) {
            best_a = (int)a;
            best_b = (int)b;
            break;
        } else {
            double temp_num, temp_den, temp_ratio;
            calculate_difference(x, y, floor(a), b, temp_num, temp_den);
            temp_ratio = temp_num / temp_den;

            if (temp_ratio < min_ratio) {
                min_ratio = temp_ratio;
                best_a = (int)floor(a);
                best_b = (int)b;
            } else if (temp_ratio == min_ratio && (int)floor(a) < best_a) {
                best_a = (int)floor(a);
                best_b = (int)b;
            }

            calculate_difference(x, y, ceil(a), b, temp_num, temp_den);
            temp_ratio = temp_num / temp_den;

            if (temp_ratio < min_ratio) {
                min_ratio = temp_ratio;
                best_a = (int)ceil(a);
                best_b = (int)b;
            } else if (temp_ratio == min_ratio && (int)ceil(a) < best_a) {
                best_a = (int)ceil(a);
                best_b = (int)b;
            }
        }
    }

    int g = compute_gcd(best_a, best_b);
    if (g != 1) {
        best_a /= g;
        best_b /= g;
    }
    cout << best_a << "/" << best_b << endl;
    return 0;
}
